Extracting the success-path shape-capture logic into a module-level helper function will reduce PydanticAIRunner.run complexity back to <=24 without regenerating the baseline
The extracted helper must preserve the success-path key merge behavior (usage_log.run_shape, shape_only, limits, duration capture) provable via existing test assertions
The extracted helper must swallow run_shape/shape_only failures with warning log and leave the usage dict unchanged
